blocks.title: Read slowly, ask naturally, remember what matters
blocks.description: Shimo keeps the page quiet until you need help. Read books, poetry and articles in Chinese or English, select a passage to ask Vetta, show pinyin above Chinese characters, and keep every note with the copy you are studying.

showcase.user_prompt: Explain this line of poetry, show pinyin above the Chinese characters, and save the interpretation with my reading notes.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll keep the selected line as context, explain its literal meaning and imagery, add pinyin in place, and save the answer to this reading record automatically.

blocks.title: A small surface with depth when you ask for it

items.title: Progressive disclosure
items.description: The page stays focused. Category-aware actions appear only after you select text, with no second chat interface to learn.

items.title: Bilingual study
items.description: Read Chinese, English or mixed materials. Pinyin sits above the corresponding characters, while explanations and prompts follow the current language.

items.title: Records that travel with the copy
items.description: Imported materials are copied into Shimo's private library. Highlights, thoughts, AI answers and revisions remain available offline.

items.title: Install Shimo and choose a document
items.description: Open a PDF, Markdown or TXT file from the file explorer. Shimo creates a private copy before you begin.

items.title: Select when something catches
items.description: Use the small category-aware action bar for explanation, poetry analysis, pinyin, translation, a note or a question to Vetta.

items.title: Return to the thought later
items.description: Answers save automatically in the existing Vetta conversation and as a reading record. Export records using a filename based on the material's title.

blocks.title: OCR is local by default
blocks.content: Shimo uses Vetta's built-in local OCR Provider by default. Remote OCR is an optional future Provider Plugin protocol, not a bundled vendor integration; a remote Provider is never selected silently.
